newsLog.event: October advance retail sales rose 0.2%, in line with estimates. The control group beat at +0.6%, and September was revised up, so consumer spending looks solid while the Fed is leaning toward hikes.

newsLog.event: US futures were mixed after Monday's sharp sell-off. Dow and Russell futures fell, while Nasdaq futures edged up ahead of Nvidia's results after the close, its first report since Jensen Huang resigned. Nvidia also disclosed cuts to its Intel, Nokia and Synopsys stakes.
newsLog.numbers: Dow futures ~-0.8% to -0.9%, S&P 500 futures ~-0.2%, Nasdaq-100 futures ~+0.2%, Russell 2000 futures ~-0.5%; VIX ~23; 10Y ~5.14%; NVDA ~flat to -0.4% pre-market; NVDA est EPS $2.47 on $109.15B revenue; INTC -3%+
newsLog.reaction: Tech holding up slightly better than the broader market after the selloff; positioning stays cautious before Nvidia reports.
newsLog.tickers: SPY, S&P, QQQ, Nasdaq, IWM, Russell, NVDA, INTC

newsLog.event: Home Depot beat on revenue, raised its full-year sales outlook and named CFO Richard McPhail as CEO. Disney beat fiscal Q4 estimates. Red Cat plunged after a large revenue miss, and JD.com fell on a miss.
newsLog.numbers: HD Q3 revenue $43.4B vs $42.8B est, adj EPS $3.86 vs $3.85; FY26 sales growth ~4.5% (top of range); HD ~-0.9% pre-market. DIS adj EPS $1.77 vs $1.68, revenue $25.9B vs $25.2B; DIS ~+2%. RCAT revenue $11.77M vs ~$42M est, -25.8%. JD revenue 309.6B yuan vs 311.48B est, -3.4%
newsLog.reaction: Mixed single-stock moves; Home Depot's beat met by a muted response with the CEO change.
newsLog.vsExp: HD beat/raise; DIS beat; RCAT and JD missed

newsLog.event: Stocks closed broadly lower as AI-linked names led losses ahead of Nvidia's earnings after the bell. Financials were also heavy; Treasury yields held little changed while oil rose, and European and Asian indexes fell too.
newsLog.numbers: S&P 500 -1.0% to 7,340.53; Dow -1.6% (-848.75 pts) to 50,759.42; Nasdaq Composite -0.7% to 24,328.38; Russell 2000 -1.5% to 2,701.87; 10-yr Treasury yield ~5.14-5.16%, little changed
newsLog.reaction: Broad risk-off into Nvidia's first earnings since Jensen Huang's resignation; Dow underperformed on old-economy/financial weakness.

newsLog.event: Nvidia beat Q3 FY2027 estimates and issued strong Q4 guidance in its first earnings report since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO; interim CEO Colette Kress said the company's 'roadmap is on track.' Separately, the WSJ reported the SEC is probing Nvidia following Huang's departure, though the news had little market impact.
newsLog.numbers: Adj EPS $2.68 vs $2.48 est; revenue $115.84B vs $109.10B est (more than doubled y/y from $57B); Q4 revenue guidance ~$130B vs $125.1B est; non-GAAP gross margin 74.9% vs ~74% est
